dispatch_blocker.fresh_observation: Four distinct JAL stubs resolve via .rel.plt type 127 to memcpy. Stub LUI t7; LW t9; JR t9; ADDIU t8 in delay slot preserves live v0. Initial GOT slot points to PLT0. PLT0 sets gp/t8/t7 and performs JALR t9 without killing v0. Interpreter /lib/libc.so contains musl marker; inspected exported symbols did not identify a resolver entry to prove its live-in handling.
dispatch_blocker.inherited_bounded_fact: Prior readiness evidence established local memcpy starts MOVE v0,a0 and immediately kills incoming v0. This session rechecked libc hashes and memcpy symbol metadata, not a complete resolver implementation.
dispatch_blocker.not_claimed: The initial slot does not prove lazy binding occurs at runtime; eager binding may replace it. Nor does ABI caller-saved status alone prove no resolver observation. Interposition, alternate symbol resolution and indirect-entry safety remain unproved.
dispatch_blocker.decision: Reject all actual candidates rather than assume safe transformation. Preserve blocked envelope reports and fail overlap before returning zero coverage.
dispatch_blocker.next_step: Independent review of prototype and bounded static proof of actual loader binding/dispatch including incoming v0, or retain rejection. Loader ten-limb semantics and product-specific runtime policy remain separate blockers.

implemented_checks: Immutable bytes and <=4MiB input bound; four exact whole-file pins; unknown/repatched sources rejected.
Mandatory ELF section and RX PT_LOAD ownership, nonoverlapping file/VA regions, aligned fixed-width code, bounded metadata and relocation/symbol tables.
Capstone required; complete decode with exact instruction boundaries plus raw opcode/register/store checks; no assert-based safety gates.
Fixed argument setup, JAL and final SW delay slot preserved. Reserved envelope includes post-return v0 kill.
Signed ADDIU compensated high half, unsigned ORI separately encoded per pinned endian layout. Only sixteen immediate fields can change.
Direct branch/jump/likely/coprocessor interior-entry, delay-slot entry, defined-symbol and relocation exclusions. Generic indirect-control-flow proof is not claimed.

All-mapping planner reserves every pristine literal/envelope and full immutable 12-byte proved callee range, rejects overlap regardless of mapping order and blocked call status, rejects containment/cascade inputs, and returns instruction plans only. Occupied spans protect both construction and callee; inspection exposes callee_range separately.
Production _replace_keys remains unchanged and contributes no synthetic MIPS instruction coverage. No loader preservation or transform policy.

P2_followup.prior_defect: The boolean _call_proved result depended on an immutable 12-byte leaf callee, but occupied/planner preflight reserved only construction. A second literal mapping could replace the initial v0 kill with an instruction reading incoming v0. Reproduced with synthetic repinned fixtures in both mapping orders and all four layouts; real pins remained rejected.
P2_followup.fix: _call_proved now returns the complete callee file range or None. Inspection exposes callee_range. Both occupied checking and all-mapping pristine preflight protect the full callee range alongside construction. Replacement tuple formats remain unchanged and callee bytes are never written.
P2_followup.regressions: All four layouts: each of 12 callee bytes as occupied, full and edge-straddling occupied ranges, destructive first-instruction literal mappings in both orders, every byte-changing full-leaf mapping in both orders, reported callee_range, adjacent nonoverlapping spans accepted, and callee preservation after construction replacement.
